description: NaSrWInO₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic F̅43m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent InO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.89 Å. Sr is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent WO₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent InO₆ octahedra. All Sr-O bond lengths are 2.89 Å. W is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form WO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent InO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All W-O bond lengths are 1.94 Å. In is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form InO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent SrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All In-O bond lengths are 2.14 Å. O is bonded to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Sr, one W, and one In atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₂Sr₂InW octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-60°.
